mcq_fix.s: How many of the following pairs are correctly matched?  1. Bhattiprolu — Mentions a ‘Nigama-sabha’ (town council) 2. Erragudi — Ashoka asked teachers to inculcate Dharma in students 3. Pedavegi — First to mention Vishnu temples in Andhra 4. Bodhisri — Evidence of Buddhism patronage under the Ikshvakus
mcq_fix.why: Bhattiprolu caskets are of pre-Satavahana Kubiraka (ye69538fabc3), not 'of the Satavahanas'

o: The Pithapuram inscription mentions Kolleru lake.
The Kalamalla inscription is identified as the first inscription in Sanskrit.
The Pedavegi inscription of Nandi Varma-II records a grant of land to Vishnu.
The Bhattiprolu inscription mentions a Nigama-sabha (town council).

patterns: APPSC asks inscription-to-issuer/content matching: Bhattiprolu = Kubiraka, Manchikallu = Pallava Simhavarman replacing Ikshvakus
Literary-source items on Reddi sea trade (Srinatha's Kashikhandam / Haravilasam) recur with differing keys
Distractors are other inscription/site names (Nasik, Nagarjunakonda, Nandampudi, Karle)
App goes much deeper (Kondamudi seal language, Eluru 'Munyada', Roman hoard spots) than the few PYQs, but stays in the same match/identify shape
